docs.presetsFlips.component: The stock flip recipes, each on its own page. A flip is GEOMETRY (a reflection the children
inherit) plus, sometimes, CONTENT (the other face). `Atoms/Flippable` teaches the atom and case A;
this shelf answers what `mirror` and `turnOver` already do, and how to configure them.
`mirror` is pure geometry, so it is shown on something that REVEALS a reflection — a row of tiles
that comes back reversed. `turnOver` is the card: a front and a back, swapped by the same turn. A
new recipe is a registration, never a branch anything has to learn.
docs.presetsFlips.mirror: Pure geometry, nothing swapped — the default. Shown on a row of distinct tiles so the reflection is
visible: flip it and they come back in reverse screen order, mirrored about `axis`. The children
inherit the reflection through the chain; nothing walks the tree. `axis` is a parameter — 90 a
Y-mirror, 76 a 76° one — not a preset per angle.
docs.presetsFlips.turnover: The card: reflection AND the other face. Even `turns` is face-up — the front; odd shows the back
surface and mirrors. The two parities do it: reflection follows a node's own turns, the content swap
the summed. An empty back would fall through to the front, so a turn never blanks the card.
